errors: Checkout trusting the displayed price is not necessarily the root cause of the refunds.
Repricing at checkout does not guarantee that stale displayed prices will cause no refunds.
A.note: Clearly retracts the unsupported recommendation and offers a useful investigation plan, but overstates what checkout repricing guarantees.

errors: Failed invalidation alone does not extend staleness beyond a correctly enforced 10-minute TTL.
Reading the database price at checkout does not guarantee prevention of refunds caused by stale displayed prices.
B.note: Provides a clear, accessible plan, but incorrectly implies that failed invalidation can override TTL expiration.
